summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload under it
details: The package's declared purpose is an ESLint/TypeScript configuration for NestJS, but its `preinstall` hook (`node setup.mjs`) is an obfuscator.io-style script (mangled `_0xNNNN` identifiers, string-array dispatcher) that downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 from `github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases`, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and then uses that freshly downloaded alternate runtime to execute `math_init.js` — a ~727KB single-line bundle with a numeric constants table, string-array rotation function, and mangled identifiers characteristic of javascript-obfuscator output. Executing a heavily obfuscated in-package bundle under a runtime downloaded at install time evades Node-based supply-chain scanners by design, and there is no legitimate reason for an ESLint config package to fetch a second language runtime or run an opaque payload at install. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: obfuscated lifecycle script + downloaded second runtime + opaque bundle executed under it, on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
